items.title: Constellation Energy Fell 9% on the Midterm Sweep. Monday’s Report Has to Defend Its Growth Estimates
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 9% in the two sessions after Democrats swept the midterms, and it reports third-quarter results on Monday, Nov. 9, before the open.

items.title: Bloom Energy Rises 2%, AMD Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound From Midterm Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 2% today as AI stocks, AMD among them, bounced back from Thursday’s post-midterm selloff. Bloom had just landed a 900-megawatt NTT DATA deal and a 1-gigawatt plan with California Resources.

items.title: AI Party isn't Ending Because Of The Blue Wave Says Ives
items.summary: Technology stocks plunged the most since 2020 on Thursday as investors exited the sector on concerns over the artificial intelligence trade after Democrats swept the US midterm elections. Dan Ives, Partner and Senior Managing Director, Analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co joins to discuss.

items.title: GE Vernova Has Something Nvidia Needs Under a Democratic Congress
items.summary: Industrial stocks are sliding on fears of a Democratic sweep, yet one power equipment maker keeps stacking orders while its stock gets cheaper. This investor sees the selloff as a buying window, and the reasons go beyond politics.
